questions.question: Against which tribe did the rest of Israel go to war?
Why did Israel fight that tribe?
options: It had taken land belonging to one of the other tribes
It had seized water rights from a neighbor
It had crowned a king without the others
It refused to hand over the wicked men of Gibeah
questions.answer: It refused to hand over the wicked men of Gibeah

questions.question: The tribe of Benjamin was nearly wiped out in the war.
